text: Visitors have raised concerns about crowding and the timed entry system, noting that the museum can feel cramped and difficult to navigate, especially in the early sections. Several reviews mention frustration with the heavy use of AI in interactive exhibits, describing it as excessive or detracting from the experience. Accessibility questions have been difficult to resolve by phone, and payment issues were reported, including problems with international cards and the lack of cash acceptance. On the positive side, many visitors appreciate the architecture and the amount of information available, but some feel the gift shop offerings are limited. Overall, while the average rating remains high, attention is needed on crowd management, communication, and the balance of technology in exhibits.
